facts.value: For an ID fitting six bits, GXSetCurrentMtx replaces bits 0–5 of gx->matIdxA while preserving neighboring texture-matrix index fields. SET_REG_FIELD asserts that the ID fits, but its assignment clears only those six destination bits and ORs the entire unmasked ID; with assertions disabled, an out-of-range ID can set neighboring bits rather than being truncated to six bits. __GXSetMatrixIndex(GX_VA_PNMTXIDX) publishes the complete matIdxA word through command-processor register selector 0x30 and XF register 24, then assigns gx->bpSent = 1. This emits matrix-selection commands; it neither uploads matrix coefficients nor waits for GPU completion.
facts.rationale: Preserves the supported field/register flow and correction of global-synchronization wording while repairing the reviewer's substantive objection about unmasked out-of-range IDs.

evidence.why: Six-bit PN field update and helper call.
Range assertion followed by destination-field clearing and an unmasked value OR.
Complete shadow-word publication and numeric bookkeeping assignment.
Command macro emits the opcode, register selector, and word without a completion wait.

facts.value: Applies the GXBegin guard and asserts left < 1708, top < 1708, left + wd < 1708, and top + ht < 1708 using unsigned arguments. It adds 342 to the origins and computes inclusive bottom/right bounds by adding dimensions and subtracting one. Four SET_REG_FIELD calls update the 11-bit scissor fields; each asserts that its value fits, but ORs an unmasked value after clearing the destination field, so field-contained replacement assumes fitting values. It emits both raster-register words and assigns gx->bpSent = 0. The zero assignment is bookkeeping after actual register emission, not evidence that the BP commands were unsent. No explicit nonzero-dimension check is present.
facts.rationale: Preserves the supported correction of bpSent=0 and the exact assertion and size-edge behavior. Macro inspection additionally avoids implying that arbitrary out-of-range values are masked to eleven bits.

evidence.why: Validation, bound arithmetic, four field updates, raster writes, and zero assignment.
Field-update macro asserts range without masking its input operand.
Raster macro emits a command byte and register word.

facts.value: Implements raster scissor configuration for HSD camera render regions. Normal camera setup scales the CObj scissor bounds into its framebuffer rectangle. Top-half setup instead derives a rectangle from CObj viewport bounds and caps its bottom at efbHeight. Bottom-half setup derives its rectangle from CObj scissor bounds relative to screen_top = efbHeight - 8. Each path passes origin and dimensions to GXSetScissor for raster-register installation.
facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline rationale's conflation of top-half viewport-derived bounds with CObj scissor fields, while retaining the established camera/raster mapping.

evidence.why: Normal scissor-field conversion and top-half viewport-derived rectangle.
Bottom-half scissor fields and efbHeight-8 origin.
